page.layout: One blank page. A dark ink stamp (a crest with a lion-like figure holding a shield) stands near the centre. A torn paper label with handwriting, and handwritten marks along the left edge, are not printed text.
page.notes: No printed text on this page. The central ink stamp is an ownership mark, not printed text, so it is left out. The handwriting along the left edge and on the paper label at the lower left (a numeral and fragments) is manuscript or label writing, also left out.
